parameters.query:
SELECT 
  c_dep.atlas_city_id AS departure_atlas_id,
  c_dep.name AS departure_name,
  c_arr.atlas_city_id AS arrival_atlas_id,
  c_arr.name AS arrival_name,
  s.date,
  json_agg(
    json_build_object(
      'subscription_id', s.subscription_id,
      'telegram_id', u.telegram_id,
      'time_from', s.time_from,
      'time_to', s.time_to
    )
  ) AS subscribers
FROM subscription s
JOIN "user" u ON s.user_id = u.user_id
JOIN city c_dep ON s.departure_city_id = c_dep.city_id
JOIN city c_arr ON s.arrival_city_id = c_arr.city_id
WHERE s.status = 'ACTIVE' 
  AND s.date >= CURRENT_DATE
GROUP BY 
  c_dep.atlas_city_id, 
  c_dep.name, 
  c_arr.atlas_city_id, 
  c_arr.name, 
  s.date;

UPDATE subscriptions 
SET 
  last_notified_status = '{{ $json.status }}',
  last_notified_at = NOW(),
  -- Если нашли билеты — завершаем подписку (чтобы больше не мониторить). 
  -- Если нужно продолжать мониторинг — оставь status = 'ACTIVE'.
  status = CASE 
    WHEN '{{ $json.status }}' = 'FOUND' THEN 'COMPLETED' 
    ELSE status 
  END
WHERE id = {{ $json.subscription_id }};
